faq_heading: Homes near Sands Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Sands Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Sands Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names Sands Secondary. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 2 km away.

How the Sands Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Sands Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away.
